The work through an Author’s eyes

Words make worlds. Worlds teach us what to notice.

See all projects ↓

Foundation & platform

Give an imagined world a coherent frame.

Temple and Sourcery provide an explicit way to describe behaviour and compose its parts. I’m interested in how that can support a world whose choices and changes remain understandable.

ExecutionFoundation

Temple

Accountable execution. Explicit rules, checked changes and a history you can inspect.

A world needs a dependable account of how its rules act.

Explore ↗Inspect

PlatformBuilt on Temple

Sourcery

Author meaning and compose systems, built on Temple.

Compose the pieces of an interactive world in a common language.
